definitions.explanation: The front part of the body between the chest and hips. Most commonly used when talking about hunger or stomach-related feelings.

examples.japanese: お{腹|なか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{空|す}きました→すく：00756_suku⟧。
examples.notes: The most common way to express hunger in Japanese

examples.japanese: お{腹|なか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いっぱい→一杯：01793_ippai⟧です。
お{腹|なか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧です。
お{腹|なか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{空|す}いたら→すく：00756_suku⟧、⟦{何|なに}か→何か：03873_nanika⟧⟦{食|た}べましょう→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: If you get hungry, let's eat something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{腹|なか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦やわらかい→柔らかい：01096_yawarakai⟧。

notes:
お{腹|なか} refers to the stomach/belly area. The お prefix is standard; dropping it sounds rough.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- お{腹|なか}が{空|す}く: to get hungry
- お{腹|なか}が{空|す}いた: I'm hungry
- お{腹|なか}がいっぱい: to be full
- お{腹|なか}が{痛|いた}い: stomach hurts
- お{腹|なか}を{壊|こわ}す: to have an upset stomach
- お{腹|なか}が{鳴|な}る: stomach growls

RELATED FORMS:
- {腹|はら}: stomach (rough/masculine; used in expressions)
- {腹|はら}が{立|た}つ: to get angry (idiom)
- {腹|はら}{八分目|はちぶんめ}: eating until 80% full

NOTE:
お{腹|なか}が{空|す}いた is one of the first essential phrases learners need.
